title: The Foal Is Coming
offer: My mare Silke is about to foal, and she is restless. Please fetch Tova from Laxön, quickly! Tova takes the room of a crate in your boat.

steps.load_say: A foal? I come at once. Let me sit in the bow.

steps.say: A little filly, with white socks! She stands already. When she is grown, she is yours: I promise.

fact: A foal can stand and walk within an hour of being born.
